pr_title: drivers/disk: sdmmc: stm32: configurable SDMMC bus width
pr_body:
Make the SDMMC bus width for STM32 configurable.
Fixes #45021.

Signed-off-by: Benedikt Schmidt <benedikt.schmidt@embedded-solutions.at>
pr_comments: @benediktibk Have you been able to test that 2 new bus widths are functional and provide expected performance gain ?

> @benediktibk Have you been able to test that 2 new bus widths are functional and provide expected performance gain ?

I tested it with a bus width of 4 on a STM32H7. The raw disk read performance increased from 3784,6 kB/s to 11794,2 kB/s.
Unfortunately I do not have hardware available with 8 lines.
@ABOSTM @FRASTM Could another one please go through this?
@ABOSTM @FRASTM @erwango Is it possible to get this reviewed before the feature freeze?
After the latest changes this is now broken, will have to fix it.
@erwango The block with the mapping from the device tree property to the config value is necessary, as they do not match. And I suppose they could even differ on the SoC.

> @erwango The block with the mapping from the device tree property to the config value is necessary, as they do not match. And I suppose they could even differ on the SoC.

Ok,got it. Txs

issue_context.title: Configurable SDMMC bus width for STM32
issue_context.body:
**Is your enhancement proposal related to a problem? Please describe.**
I have a pretty bad disk access performance on a STM32H7 due to only one out of 4 bus lines being used.

**Describe the solution you'd like**
I would like to use all 4 bus lines.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
None really available, besides not using the zephyr driver and doing it manually.
